meaning:
θυρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(dim, of θύρα), [in LXX chiefly for חַלּוֹן ;]
a window: Act.20:9, 2Co.11:33.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down…
I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
